args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity, unbounded
recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Upgrade the pin to 2.9.4,
the fixed version in the 2.x line.

files.content:
# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.
- Fixes CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).
- Adds a changelog entry under Unreleased.

## Advisory details
- CVE-2026-31337: fastjson <2.9.4 (and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0) are affected; fixed in 2.9.4 (2.x line) and 3.1.0.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit 6c69ace862 passed.

Reviewer: @alex
